After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] created a '''miniature empire''' in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Teradoc would alternatively ally with and against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], and he had great succuss in his military campiagns.<ref name="Despoilers 2" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> Kosh's brother, [[Treuten Teradoc]] had overextended himself in the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|campaigns]] following Warlord Zsinj's death, and found himself in need of his brother Kosh's [[Kosh Teradoc's empire's military|vast military forces]]. The brothers Teradoc then formed the [[Federated Teradoc Union]], and expanded the Union's territory be conquering toward each other.<ref name="Despoilers 2" />
